news.detail: The Cowboys scored touchdowns on each of their first six possessions against Tennessee, so Aubrey was busy kicking extra points. His field goal was good from 49 yards in the second half. It's been a struggle at times for Aubrey this season, as he's made just 20 of 25 field-goal tries through 11 game
